notes: The catalog text holds no section for the Management I Certificate of Achievement. The only management section is 'MANAGEMENT AS DEGREE'. That section requires ACCTG 101 and BUSAD 101, 110 and 141. It also has four choices: Writing (BUSAD 106 or CABOT 105), Business (BUSAD 120 or 144), Speaking (BUSAD 152 or COMM C1000) and Computer (CABOT 260 or CS/IS 100 or 101).

The AS degree requirements, outcomes and description were not recorded because they belong to a different award. A reviewer should find the Management I certificate section, likely on another catalog page.
The closed list (BUSAD 101, BUSAD 141, and BUSAD 152 or COMM C1000) suggests the certificate may be a subset of the AS core. This is not stated in the text.
